form_title: Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates

reports.report_type_printed: Seven days preceding the Primary Election
reports.notes: Typed fillable form, photocopied/scanned but crisp. Boxes A, B, D, E print a leading '$' (dropped per spec); C, F, G do not. This filing is NOT redacted - the street address (869 S 1100 E, Orem, UT 84097) and a wet signature are visible; only residence_city is recorded here per package privacy practice. The Email field is blank on the form. This form labels the close box 'G'; key kept as 'balance_at_close' to match the reference cache shape. Figures are unusually large for a county race but are exactly as printed and are internally consistent (A+B=F, F-D=G).

notes: index.csv variant_guess was legacy_colAB; the filing is the modern Box A-F form. No version string printed in the footer (the footer band is washed out in the scan).
